verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs mention Browserbase's session dashboard offering real-time browser screen recording and replay, which covers 'watching a session live,' but there is no evidence of a mechanism to hand control back to a human mid-run when the agent stalls. missing for 10: explicit live take-over/human-in-the-loop control feature, evidence of pausing agent execution for manual intervention, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
